title: Expect Crisis To Occur
text: [Music] a person faces a situation that we call a crisis your interpretation of a crisis is what makes it a crisis you know paul the apostle said something important paul says all things work together for my good now that sounds like a nice statement but that's a tough statement someone just lost their job watching this program they just got a pink slip and they supposed to say this is working for my good well if they don't understand how god uses crisis it could become a point of depression i have a little list in the book i talk about what crisis create let's look at a few of them the loss of a job could be a crisis the death of a child is a crisis the death of a spouse the collapse of a business the the terminal disease that's in a body is a crisis a divorce that's a crisis for someone loss of a home a repossession by the bank that's a crisis an unmarried pregnant daughter could be a crisis to someone a drug addict child that's a crisis for someone a death of a parent in other words crisis is not just economic conditions it's anything that happens to you that you couldn't control or you couldn't stop and what what is the impact of a crisis fear trauma depression despair frustration anxiety loneliness abandonment worry hopelessness a sense of laws even the threat of suicide these are the impact of crisis on a person's body on a person's life even crime and domestic violence are products of crisis many people today are under stress in their homes because if the husband lost his job let's say uh you know gm you know shut down the plant and the husband lost his job he's the only one working imagine the stress in that family in that home the first thing you got to understand with a crisis is that a crisis is only seasonal i think one of the most beautiful things that god ever taught me is that nothing is forever except him and his promises the joy of life is that god gives us life in doses the bible says as long as the earth remains there'll be harvest and sea time there'll be good time and bad times there'll be summer and winter and unlike what the scriptures say too it says to everything there is a season in other words nothing lasts forever if you are broke right now that's only a season it cannot last wealth is on the way and if you are wealthy right now you must use that wealth strategically and properly because there will come a time when that wealth may be challenged in other words everything is for a season and the good thing is that if you are in a dungeon right now light is on the way if you are in pain right now health is on the way if you are abandoned right now a company is coming to meet you you see nothing remains forever nothing in life lasts forever except god even your marriage will go through seasons you know i tell people all the time uh if your husband or wife is not doing well right now don't divorce them why that's a temporary insanity they are going through a season of insanity it can't last the issue in life is remaining steady until the season passes can i say it again key to success in life is outlasting the season and that could be a season of good time or bad time here's something i learned i talk about in the book and that is the greatest protection against crisis is to expect it in this world you shall suffer many tribulations as a matter of fact jesus said something about crisis he says if you follow me in my kingdom he says and you believe my word he promises now he says you will be like a man who built his house on a rock the storm come the winds blew the waves rose and the great clash hit the house and it stood firm he says if you don't follow my word it's like a man who built his house on the sand the winds blew the storms rose the waters came and that house fell see we who are in the kingdom of god we believe that we are immune to crisis so we've got someone listening to this program right now to say well i paid my tithe i went to church i was faithful why did i lose my job well he did say that the wind would hit all houses because you are a believer doesn't insulate you from storms but he does guarantee your house won't fall the key is not whether you have a crisis or not the key is what are you built on
